name: VANDIRA Issue & Ground Intelligence
purpose: Evidence-grounded issue and ground-signal layer for Uttar Pradesh Assembly Election 2027.
inputs: future verified field reports and survey datasets when available
rules: News mentions are evidence leads, not constituency-wide public opinion measurements
Do not claim an issue is the top voter priority without survey or representative ground evidence
No sensitive demographic inference or voter profiling
Historical election results remain separate from issue evidence
ground_data_status: No verified constituency ground-report or scientific survey dataset is embedded in STEP105; future datasets must carry source, geography, date, methodology and provenance metadata.
recommended_consultant_sequence: separate evidence leads from measured public opinion
